profile.name: 集群数据流传输组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验数据采集过程中以异步、非阻塞方式将文件或数据持续传输到集群节点或单个服务器，并保持与各节点的持久连接，适合显微成像等实验中的数据后台流式写入与分发。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for asynchronously and non-blockingly streaming files or data to a single server or multiple cluster nodes during experiments. It maintains persistent connections to nodes and is suited for background data spooling and distribution in workflows such as microscopy data acquisition.
